title: BOX OF COLLECTORS CHINA INCLUD...
reason: Includes two signed Brownie Downing printed plates, a known Australian collectable artist, plus a Royal Albert Lady Carlyle vase.
findings: Two small plates printed with Aboriginal children and native animals, each carrying the black signature 'Brownie Downing' (read clearly on both; it looks like a printed transfer facsimile, not hand signed). One shows a child with a flower cart pulled by two koalas, the other a child riding a bird among pink and grey birds. The plate backs and potter's marks were not photographed, so the maker and date are unconfirmed. Also in the lot: a Royal Albert 'Lady Carlyle' bone china vase (backstamp reads BONE CHINA, ROYAL ALBERT, Lady Carlyle), four Wedgwood Home 'Vintage Blue' earthenware cups with about four saucers (backstamp 'Wedgwood Home Vintage Blue (c) Wedgwood 1996', so modern), boxed commemorative mugs with portraits of the late Queen Elizabeth II (box text not legible; two open boxes of two plus two more boxes behind), and a cat-pattern painted jar with a wooden lid. No web price check was possible, so strength is from general knowledge.
condition: Plates have a yellowed cream ground and no chips seen. Royal Albert vase has brown staining and speckling around the foot rim and base. Mugs look boxed and unused. Wedgwood cups look clean.
rescore_note: Two printed Brownie Downing plates are the draw but maker and date are unconfirmed. The Royal Albert vase is stained, the Wedgwood Home cups are 1996 and the Queen mugs are modern, so the top of the $30 to $80 band. General knowledge, no web check.
